snapshot_note: Snapshot for tests and as a starting point. SubmitReady re-reads the live guidelines on every run.

requirements.rule: About 5,000 words (up to 7 pages), not counting figures
requirements.quote: Up to 7 pages; this is approx. 5,000 words. excluding figures.
A maximum of 150 words is recommended.

requirements.rule: Structured abstract: Motivation, Results, Availability and Implementation, Contact, Supplementary Information
Title page, Structured Abstract, Introduction, System and methods, Algorithm, Implementation, Discussion, References
requirements.quote: Title page, Structured Abstract, Introduction, System and methods, Algorithm, Implementation, Discussion, References.

requirements.rule: Machine learning papers have a methods subsection on training data, cross-validation sets and an independent test set
At submission, figures are embedded in the main file with their legends next to them
Final figures: 1200 dpi line art, 350 dpi colour and halftone; 86 mm or 178 mm wide; alt text under each caption
Author-date citations, per the journal's CSL style
A section titled "Funding", with agencies in full and grant numbers
Data availability statement in the paper; datasets cited with accession identifiers
Supplementary text, figures and tables in one separate file, referred to in the main text
Generative AI use is disclosed in the cover letter and in Methods or Acknowledgements
